<!-- Thank you for your contribution! Please follow these guidelines to enhance your pull request. If anything is unclear, submit your PR and reach out to maintainers for assistance. Join our Slack community at https://slack.sglang.io to discuss further. -->

<!-- PR title: [Type] scope: title, or [Type] [Hardware] scope: title.
Type: Feat, Fix, Refactor, Perf, Doc, Test, CI, or Chore.
Scope: any module or model name (no fixed list or letter-case restriction), e.g. attention, qwen3, or flash-attn.
Hardware: optional single tag without spaces. Use uppercase hardware tags (AMD, NVIDIA, NPU, MI300X), except for exactly these four spellings: Intel, Apple, Huawei, Ascend.
Title: no letter-case restriction.
Reverts: use GitHub's default title, Revert "original title".
Examples: [Fix] attention: Fix KV cache indexing; [Perf] [AMD] flash-attn: Optimize decode performance. -->

## Motivation

DeepSeek-V4.1 differs from V4 in every layer that touches KV: it compresses at ratios 1/2 instead of 4/128, runs a two-level indexer (level-1 block candidates, level-2 QSLI rescore inside them), stores two different quantized row formats (FP8 E4M3 group 32 for the window side, packed FP4 E2M1 group 16 for the compressed side), and drives mHC residual mixing through CANN ops. The NPU backend only covered V4: `npu_kv_quant_sparse_attn_sharedkv` for attention, ratios 0/4/128, one indexer level, and the 584-byte A5 row. Enabling V4.1 on Ascend A5 therefore needs a new source/attention path, new pools, graph-capture support, PD/HiCache descriptors, and a few operator gaps closed (medium-row argmax, fp8/e8m0 byte views, copysign-free gating, w8a8 mxfp8 GEMM).

## Modification

### Attention backend (`hardware_backend/npu/attention/ascend_dsv4_backend.py`)

- Add `LowRatioCompressAscendBackendMixin` with three seams: **A** `_low_ratio_compress` runs the fused `ds41.compressor` (ratio 2) or the plain `wkv` projection (ratio 1), then RMSNorm + RoPE and a write into the ratio's compressed pool, handing the pre-RoPE latent to seam B; **B** `_low_ratio_index_topk` calls `ds41.indexer_prologue_k` (storage_mode 0/1) and then either level-1 top-k with candidate publish or level-2 QSLI rescore; **D** `_forward_low_ratio_attention` runs `ds41.mixed_quant_sparse_flash_mla` with the window and compressed sides as explicit sparse indices + lengths.
- Discriminate generations by `compress_ratios` (both report `KVLayout.V4` on NPU), reject cross-generation ratios, assert the fixed 64 query heads, and reject COMPACT ragged verify at startup.
- Metadata: `_build_dsv41_ratio_metadata` derives slots as `full_loc // ratio` (ratio 1 masks in place to keep token order, ratio > 1 stable-compacts), expands the full page table to the index pool granularity, and builds the QLI / QSLI dispatch tables from the batch's final KV length.
- aclgraph: allocate the low-ratio buffers at capture and refresh them in place on replay (decode, verify, DP-idle clear); keep `seq_lens_cpu_int` on one persistent buffer and refresh a dedicated live-row mask so an idle dummy verify window stays dead inside the replay.
- DSpark owns the V4.1 verify replay; EAGLE fails loudly instead of scattering compressed rows into the previous step's slots.

### Pools (`hardware_backend/npu/dsv4/dsv4_memory_pool.py`)

- `DSV41NPUSingleKVPool`: fully quantized rows (window FP8 E4M3 g32 / 544 B, compressed packed FP4 E2M1 g16 / 320 B), format picked by the pool's role rather than the layer's ratio (a ratio-1 compressed pool keeps the global page size but still takes the fp4 row).
- `DSV41NPUIndexerPool`: packed-fp4 index K and E8M0 scales kept in separate PA_ND buffers; no CUDA fused packed buffer allocated.
- Ratio-2 pending-pair state exposed as a physical `[blocks, ring, 2*D]` bank so `state_cache_3d` is valid for the A5 CYCLE ABI.
- `get_contiguous_buf_infos` describes the V4.1 pools for PD (KV, index K, index scale per ratio, one item per full page); C128 infos stay empty.

### Model / cache / allocator

- `deepseek_v4.py`: V4.1 skips per-head Q norm, disables the NPU multi-stream split (compressor + indexer is one ordered call), and collapses the mHC premix on NPU.
- `deepseek_v4_mhc.py`: NPU premix path (`npu_hc_pre` with the identity one-hot seed, empty-batch short circuit) and the A5 `cann_ops_transformer.mhc_post` (`mhc_post(x, hRes, hOut, hPost)`).
- DSpark / platform-stage / registry / OCR wiring for the V4.1 architecture.
- `kv_cache_configurator.py`: V4.1 stays on the generic SWA allocator (slots are `full_loc // ratio`), no C128 sidecar allocator.
- `registry.py`: attach the C128 component only when ratio-128 layers and a sidecar pool exist.
- `hybrid_pool_assembler.py`: register the NPU index K / scale PA_ND regions.

### Kernels and layers

- `row_argmax.py`: NPU medium-row argmax via one-operand `tl.max`/`tl.min` (the two-operand `tl.reduce` form does not survive Ascend triton-mlir-opt).
- `engram.py`: read the fp8 / E8M0 tables as bytes on A5 (no fp8 index or e8m0 cast), and replace `copysign` with `where` so capture does not fall back to a host copy.
- `fp8_utils.py`: dispatch 32x32-block w8a8 to `npu_w8a8_mxfp8_linear`.

### Tests

- New `test/registered/unit/npu/attention/test_npu_dsv41_low_ratio_backend.py`: CPU-runnable (pure torch + a `ds41` operator stub) coverage of row formats, pool factory, slot derivation, eager/graph parity, metadata builders, write ABI, and the verify/COMPACT guards.
- `test_deepseek_v4_platform_dispatch.py` covers the model-side dispatch.
- `5641902f10` is a lint follow-up only: line wrapping in `row_argmax.py`, `ascend_dsv4_backend.py` and the new test, one duplicate `is_npu` import removed from `fp8_utils.py`, one multi-line `if` collapsed. No behavior change.

## Accuracy Tests

<!-- If this pull request affects model outputs (e.g., changes to the kernel or model forward code), provide accuracy test results. -->

## Speed Tests and Profiling

<!-- If this pull request impacts inference speed, provide benchmarking and profiling results. -->

## Checklist

- [ ] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [ ] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

Required checks failed on ca6fbc6; this PR cannot be merged until they pass.

**Lint** ([run](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/41208673742))
Run `pre-commit run --all-files` locally and push the result. The run log shows any other failing step.

## Claude Code Review

This pull request is from a fork — automated review is disabled. A repository maintainer can comment `@claude review` to run a one-time review.

The two cache-transfer issues below need fixing before merging. I also reproduced failures in the new verify tests with CPU probes that load the methods and test cases from this commit. I haven't run the A5 kernels.

This combined K cache also needs to survive PD handoff and HiCache reload. It is a separate allocation owned by the attention backend, but `get_contiguous_buf_infos()` and `_dsv4_low_ratio_regions()` only register the compressed KV and split index K/scale buffers. The only writer here is `indexer_prologue_k(storage_mode=1)` for the current latent rows, so processing the next token does not rebuild the restored prefix. QSLI then scores history against zeros on a fresh decode worker, or stale contents after a page is reused. Please register this buffer for transfer/restore, or rebuild it from the restored split K/scale before QSLI reads it.

@@ -927,8 +983,1959 @@ def _cp_local_positions(self, forward_batch: ForwardBatch) -> torch.Tensor:
         return local if local is not None else forward_batch.positions
 
 
+class LowRatioCompressAscendBackendMixin:
+    """NPU implementation of the DeepSeek-V4.1 low-ratio (1 / 2) source path.
+
+    Mirrors ``DeepseekV4AttnBackend.forward_low_ratio_sources``
+    (layers/attention/deepseek_v4_backend.py L3203-L3281) but keeps its own
+    orchestration rather than sharing the CUDA backend's, for the same reason
+    :class:`C4IndexerAscendBackendMixin` and
+    :class:`CompressorAscendBackendMixin` do: ``deepseek_v4_backend`` imports
+    Triton kernels at module scope, and the two generations differ in the
+    kernels and the cache row formats, not in the skeleton.
+
+    Deliberately dropped relative to the CUDA source (unreachable on NPU):
+      * the context-parallel branch (``_forward_low_ratio_sources_cp``);
+      * the prefill-graph branch — :attr:`low_ratio_prefill_graph` stays False.
+
+    Intentional deviation from the CUDA source: seam A hands its pre-RoPE
+    ``latent`` to seam B, because ``indexer_prologue_k`` projects the index K
+    from that latent (``wk: [index_head_dim, head_dim]``).  CUDA needs no such
+    handoff: it writes the index K *inside* its compress step, where the same
+    latent already exists (``_low_ratio_write_group`` ->
+    ``indexer.forward_wk(latent)``, deepseek_v4_backend.py L3613-L3643),
+    whereas on NPU the fused ``indexer_prologue_k`` is a separate op call.
+
+    Each method notes its CUDA anchor; keep them in sync when upstream
+    semantics change (see the plan's drift checklist).
+    """
+
+    # CUDA-only prefill graph (BCG). The model reads this via
+    # getattr(attn_backend, "low_ratio_prefill_graph", False)
+    # (deepseek_v4.py L2391) to choose the two-call side-stream contract over
+    # the single call, so declaring False is what selects L2397-2403 on NPU.
+    low_ratio_prefill_graph = False
+    # Written by the model / replay-tail path exactly as on CUDA
+    # (deepseek_v4_backend.py L2012 / L2067, deepseek_v4_replay_tail.py L637).
+    tail_source_kv_layer_id: Optional[int] = None
+
+    def forward_low_ratio_sources(
+        self,
+        *,
+        layer,
+        x,
+        q_lora,
+        positions,
+        forward_batch,
+        run_compressor: bool = True,
+        run_indexer: bool = True,
+    ) -> None:
+        """Runs on every ratio 1/2 layer before its attention.
+
+        Anchor: DeepseekV4AttnBackend.forward_low_ratio_sources
+        (deepseek_v4_backend.py L3203-L3281).
+        """
+        if forward_batch.forward_mode.is_idle():
+            return
+        if forward_batch.encoder_swa_replay:
+            run_compressor = False
+        if layer.layer_id == self.tail_source_kv_layer_id:
+            run_compressor = False
+
+        pos = positions
+        latent = None
+        if run_compressor and layer.compressor is not None:
+            latent = self._low_ratio_compress(layer, x, pos, forward_batch)
+        if run_indexer and layer.indexer is not None:
+            # Seam B needs the latent only to produce and store the indexer K
+            # (a layer that does not own K, e.g. a tail layer whose compressor
+            # was skipped, only scores against the stored one), so the check
+            # lives there rather than here.
+            self._low_ratio_index_topk(layer, latent, x, q_lora, pos, forward_batch)
+
+    def _low_ratio_compress(self, layer, x, pos, forward_batch):
+        """Seam A: project, normalize and RoPE one ratio-1/2 compressed latent,
+        then write it into the ratio's compressed pool.
+
+        Anchor: DeepseekV4AttnBackend._low_ratio_compress_torch
+        (deepseek_v4_backend.py L3531). Returns the pre-RoPE latent for seam B.
+        """
+        ratio = layer.compress_ratio
+        compressor = layer.compressor
+        fm = self.forward_metadata
+        if ratio == 1:
+            # No gate and no pairing for ratio 1; the recipes branch is a plain
+            # linear as well (compressor.py L127).
+            kv, _ = compressor.project(x)
+        else:
+            assert is_npu_arch35(), (
+                "the fused DeepSeek-V4.1 compressor needs Atlas A5 "
+                "(kv_compress_epilog_v2 packing); A3 is not supported."
+            )
+            # `DeepseekV41Compressor` only builds the fused `wkv_gate` where the
+            # CUDA-only fused-compress path is available; on NPU it must expose
+            # the two separate projections this call reads. Fail here rather than
+            # with an AttributeError on `compressor.wkv` deep inside the forward.
+            assert not compressor.use_fused_gate, (
+                "DeepSeek-V4.1 ratio-2 compression on NPU needs the unfused "
+                "compressor (separate wkv/wgate), but the module has wkv_gate."
+            )
+            ds41 = _ds41_ops()
+            pool = self.token_to_kv_pool
+            # Mirrors forward_compress (L453-L517) for the metadata side: A5
+            # cache_mode=2 is CYCLE, so the compressor gets one request bank per
+            # row and derives the in-bank offset from start_pos.
+            # This is the layer's attention compressor, never the nested c4-indexer
+            # one, so it always reads the attention state pool. (DeepseekV41Compressor
+            # has no `is_in_indexer`; only V4's Compressor does.)
+            state_pool = pool._get_state_pool(layer.layer_id, False)
+            kv = ds41.compressor(
+                x=x.view(-1, x.shape[-1]),
+                wkv=compressor.wkv.weight,
+                wgate=compressor.wgate.weight,
+                seqused=fm.seqused,
+                start_pos=fm.start_pos,
+                cmp_ratio=ratio,
+                cu_seqlens=fm.actual_seq_lengths_q_pa,
+                state_cache=state_pool.state_cache_3d,
+                state_block_table=fm.dsv4_cycle_state_block_table,
+            )
+        out_dim = kv.shape[-1]
+        kv = torch_npu.npu_rms_norm(kv, compressor.norm.weight, compressor.norm.eps)[0]
+        latent = kv.clone()
+
+        from sglang.srt.hardware_backend.npu.dsv4.dsv4_rope import Dsv4NpuRoPE
+
+        # DeepseekV41Compressor carries no freqs_cis of its own — unlike the V4
+        # Compressor, which is handed the layer's — so the layer's table is the
+        # rope for its compressed latents (and for the indexer K/Q below). A
+        # compress_ratio != 0 layer already builds that table with
+        # compress_rope_theta + YaRN (deepseek_v4.py L1053-L1074), which is the
+        # reference model's compress_rotary_emb.
+        freqs_cis = layer.freqs_cis
+        table = Dsv4NpuRoPE.for_freqs(freqs_cis, getattr(layer, "rotary_emb", None))
+        rope_dim = freqs_cis.shape[-1] * 2
+        cos, sin = table.get_cos_sin(
+            getattr(fm, f"positions_cmp_padding_c{ratio}"),
+            kv.dtype,
+            view_4d=True,
+            # The fp32 table is built at model init (deepseek_v4.py L1287), so a
+            # captured decode never runs repeat_interleave inside the graph.
+            allow_build=False,
+            cache_dtype=torch.float32,
+        )
+        Dsv4NpuRoPE.apply_rotary_mul_inplace(
+            kv.view(-1, 1, out_dim),
+            None,
+            cos,
+            sin,
+            qk_nope_dim=out_dim - rope_dim,
+        )
+
+        slot = getattr(fm, f"c{ratio}_loc", None)
+        if slot is None:
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                f"DeepSeek-V4.1 ratio {ratio} has no c-pool slot metadata: "
+                "the compress-loc builder has not been run for this mode yet."
+            )
+        self.token_to_kv_pool.set_compress_buffer(layer.layer_id, slot, kv, None, False)
+        return latent
+
+    def _low_ratio_index_topk(
+        self,
+        layer,
+        latent,
+        x,
+        q_lora,
+        pos,
+        forward_batch,
+        *,
+        rows_per_request=None,  # NOTE: only used under CP (unsupported here)
+    ) -> None:
+        """Seam B: store the indexer K from ``latent`` and score it with QLI.
+
+        Anchor: DeepseekV4AttnBackend._low_ratio_index_topk
+        (deepseek_v4_backend.py L3657-L3705) for the role dispatch, and
+        cann-recipes-infer models/deepseek_v4_1/models/modules/indexer.py
+        L270-L400 for the NPU operator ABI.
+        """
+        indexer = layer.indexer
+        ratio = layer.compress_ratio
+        fm = self.forward_metadata
+        if indexer.owns_k:
+            self._dsv41_index_k_store(layer, latent)
+        if indexer.is_candidate_source and not os.environ.get(
+            "SGLANG_DSV41_DISABLE_QSLI"
+        ):
+            # Level one: the plain top-k this layer attends with, plus the block
+            # candidates every later indexer layer rescoring inside.
+            topk, blocks = self._dsv41_index_full_topk(
+                layer, x, q_lora, pos, forward_batch, candidate=True
+            )
+            fm.dsv41_candidate_blocks = blocks
+        elif indexer.uses_candidates and not os.environ.get(
+            "SGLANG_DSV41_DISABLE_QSLI"
+        ):
+            topk = self._dsv41_index_qsli_topk(layer, x, q_lora, pos, forward_batch)
+        else:
+            topk, _ = self._dsv41_index_full_topk(layer, x, q_lora, pos, forward_batch)
+        setattr(fm, f"c{ratio}_topk_indices", topk)
+        # No indexer-topk capture here: get_num_indexer_layers() sizes that
+        # capturer from the ratio-4 layers (model_config.py L482-L484), which
+        # DeepSeek-V4.1 has none of, so the capturer is disabled for it -- and
+        # compress_layer_id is a per-ratio counter that collides across ratios
+        # anyway (both V4.1 sources are index 0).
+
+    def _dsv41_index_k_store(self, layer, latent) -> None:
+        """Project, norm, RoPE and quantize the index K straight into the split
+        index pool (the cache QLI reads).
+
+        Recipes: indexer.py L270-L279 (``write_prologue_k`` with storage_mode=0).
+        """
+        if latent is None:
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                "DeepSeek-V4.1 index K needs the compressor latent, but the "
+                f"compressor did not run for layer {layer.layer_id}."
+            )
+        import torch_npu
+
+        indexer = layer.indexer
+        ratio = layer.compress_ratio
+        fm = self.forward_metadata
+        pool = self.token_to_kv_pool
+        # -1 rows are the compressor's padding rows; the operator skips them, so
+        # the padded (garbage) latent rows are dropped for free.
+        cache_index = getattr(fm, f"c{ratio}_loc", None)
+        if cache_index is None:
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                f"DeepSeek-V4.1 index K for layer {layer.layer_id} has no "
+                f"c{ratio}_loc slot metadata to write into."
+            )
+        positions = getattr(fm, f"positions_cmp_padding_c{ratio}", None)
+        if positions is None:
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                f"DeepSeek-V4.1 index K for layer {layer.layer_id} has no "
+                f"positions_cmp_padding_c{ratio} metadata."
+            )
+        from sglang.srt.hardware_backend.npu.dsv4.dsv4_rope import Dsv4NpuRoPE
+
+        # indexer_prologue_k wants flat FP32 [T, Dr] RoPE tensors, unlike
+        # inplace_partial_rotary_mul's [T, 1, 1, Dr] bf16.
+        cos, sin = Dsv4NpuRoPE.for_freqs(
+            layer.freqs_cis, getattr(layer, "rotary_emb", None)
+        ).get_cos_sin(
+            positions,
+            torch.float32,
+            view_4d=False,
+            allow_build=False,
+            cache_dtype=torch.float32,
+        )
+        ds41 = _ds41_ops()
+        # The operator reads wk in FRACTAL_NZ, and the cast is deliberately
+        # *inside* the traced region: the NZ tensor is then either an
+        # intermediate node consumed straight by the op, or a constant cast
+        # at trace time -- in neither case a *graph input*, so aclgraph's
+        # input clone cannot degrade it back to ND.  The README's "ACLGraph
+        # must disable input clone" note is about a pre-cast NZ tensor that
+        # arrives *as an input*: that is the recipes layout, where
+        # modeling_deepseek.py L2854-2863 casts attn.indexer.wk in place to
+        # FRACTAL_NZ at load time and passes the parameter straight through.
+        # Casting here yields the same format without depending on that
+        # framework flag, which sglang never sets.  Do NOT hoist this cast
+        # into a cached attribute: a long-lived NZ tensor can be lifted as a
+        # graph input, which is exactly the case the README warns about.
+        # Both storage modes share every argument but the destination.
+        common = dict(
+            latent=latent.reshape(-1, latent.shape[-1]),
+            wk=torch_npu.npu_format_cast(
+                indexer.wk.weight, torch_npu.Format.FRACTAL_NZ
+            ),
+            norm_weight=indexer.k_norm.weight.to(torch.float32),
+            rope_sin=sin,
+            rope_cos=cos,
+            cache_index=cache_index.to(torch.int64),
+            norm_eps=indexer.k_norm.eps,
+        )
+        ds41.indexer_prologue_k(
+            **common,
+            k_cache=pool.get_index_k(layer.layer_id),
+            k_scale_cache=pool.get_index_scale(layer.layer_id),
+            storage_mode=0,
+        )
+        if indexer.is_candidate_source and not os.environ.get(
+            "SGLANG_DSV41_DISABLE_QSLI_CACHE"
+        ):
+            # Level-two K, read by QSLI: the same rows again, eight to a record,
+            # fused with their scales (indexer_prologue_k_dsl README L49-L52).
+            ds41.indexer_prologue_k(
+                **common,
+                k_cache=self._dsv41_qsli_cache(layer),
+                k_scale_cache=None,
+                storage_mode=1,
+                combined_block_size=indexer.candidate_block_size,
+            )
+
+    def _dsv41_index_q(self, layer, x, q_lora, pos):
+        """Packed MXFP4 Q, its E8M0 scales and the head weights, for both indexers.
+
+        Recipes: indexer.py L341-L357 and L410-L415 — QLI and QSLI take the same
+        Q side, so it is built once here for both.
+        """
+        import torch_npu
+
+        indexer = layer.indexer
+        t = int(q_lora.shape[0])
+        packed_dim = indexer.index_head_dim // 2
+
+        q, _ = indexer.wq_b(q_lora)
+        q = q.view(t, indexer.n_heads, indexer.index_head_dim)
+        from sglang.srt.hardware_backend.npu.dsv4.dsv4_rope import Dsv4NpuRoPE
+
+        # Like the compressor, DeepseekV41Indexer is built without its own
+        # freqs_cis/rotary_emb (deepseek_v4.py L1366-1372), so the layer's own
+        # table is the rope for its Q (and for the index K in
+        # _dsv41_index_k_store). A compress_ratio != 0 layer builds that table
+        # with compress_rope_theta + YaRN (L1053-L1074), which is exactly the
+        # reference model's compress_rotary_emb (recipes indexer.py L234 uses
+        # cos_sin["comp"] here).
+        table = Dsv4NpuRoPE.for_freqs(
+            layer.freqs_cis, getattr(layer, "rotary_emb", None)
+        )
+        cos, sin = table.get_cos_sin(
+            pos,
+            torch.bfloat16,
+            view_4d=True,
+            allow_build=False,
+            cache_dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+        )
+        Dsv4NpuRoPE.apply_rotary_mul_inplace(
+            q,
+            None,
+            cos,
+            sin,
+            qk_nope_dim=indexer.index_head_dim - indexer.rope_head_dim,
+        )
+        q_packed, q_scale = torch_npu.npu_dynamic_mx_quant(
+            q, dst_type=torch_npu.float4_e2m1fn_x2
+        )
+        q_packed = q_packed.view(torch.uint8).view(t, indexer.n_heads, packed_dim)
+        # QLI wants the E8M0 scales observed as [..., 2, 2]; the pool stores the
+        # same 4 bytes per row, so both are pure reshapes.
+        descale_q = q_scale.view(torch.uint8).view(t, indexer.n_heads, 2, 2)
+        w = indexer.head_weights(x).view(-1, indexer.n_heads).float()
+        return q_packed, descale_q, w
+
+    def _dsv41_index_full_topk(
+        self, layer, x, q_lora, pos, forward_batch, *, candidate: bool = False
+    ):
+        """Score the compressed history with ``quant_lightning_indexer``.
+
+        With ``candidate`` the same operator call also emits the level-one block
+        candidates, and its third and fourth returns stop being empty tensors.
+        Recipes: indexer.py L338-L400.
+        """
+        indexer = layer.indexer
+        ratio = layer.compress_ratio
+        fm = self.forward_metadata
+        pool = self.token_to_kv_pool
+        t = int(q_lora.shape[0])
+        packed_dim = indexer.index_head_dim // 2
+        q_packed, descale_q, w = self._dsv41_index_q(layer, x, q_lora, pos)
+
+        k = pool.get_index_k(layer.layer_id)
+        k_scale = pool.get_index_scale(layer.layer_id)
+        # PA_ND rows are [pages, page_rows, 1, dim]; QLI reads the packed fp4
+        # payload and its E8M0 scales as [..., 2, 2], both pure reshapes of the
+        # buffers the prologue wrote.
+        pages, page_rows = k.shape[0], k.shape[1]
+        k = k.view(pages, page_rows, 1, packed_dim)
+        descale_k = k_scale.view(torch.uint8).view(pages, page_rows, 1, 2, 2)
+
+        page_table = getattr(fm, f"c{ratio}_index_page_table", None)
+        if page_table is None:
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                f"DeepSeek-V4.1 QLI for layer {layer.layer_id} is missing the "
+                "compressed index page table."
+            )
+        # QLI's seqused_k is the compressed history length and cmp_residual_k is
+        # its unfinished-group remainder; recipes computes them as
+        # ``actual_seq_k // ratio`` and ``actual_seq_k % ratio`` (indexer.py
+        # L359-L366 feeding attention_data.py L907-L918).  actual_seq_k must
+        # include the rows THIS block writes, so verify derives the lengths
+        # from the batch's final KV length instead of device seq_lens (which
+        # stays at the live/prefix length there); decode keeps reading
+        # seq_lens.  Both are graph inputs (refreshed every replay), never a
+        # captured metadata buffer that would keep the capture-time lengths.
+        kv_lens = self._dsv41_qli_kv_lens(forward_batch)
+        # Same generation-agnostic `index_topk` the QLI metadata op and the graph
+        # buffer are sized with (L1336 / L1761); the op both selects and reshapes
+        # with it.
+        topk = self._dsv4_index_topk
+        key = (
+            f"c{ratio}a_qli_candidate_metadata"
+            if candidate
+            else f"c{ratio}a_qli_metadata"
+        )
+        metadata = fm.kernel_metadata.get(key)
+        if metadata is None:
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                f"DeepSeek-V4.1 QLI for layer {layer.layer_id} has no {key}; the "
+                "kernel-metadata builder must run before the source layers."
+            )
+        result = _ds41_ops().quant_lightning_indexer(
+            q=q_packed,
+            k=k,
+            w=w,
+            descale_q=descale_q,
+            descale_k=descale_k,
+            topk=topk,
+            quant_mode=1,
+            cu_seqlens_q=fm.actual_seq_lengths_q_pa,
+            seqused_q=None,
+            seqused_k=(kv_lens // ratio).to(torch.int32),
+            cmp_residual_k=(None if ratio == 1 else (kv_lens % ratio).to(torch.int32)),
+            block_table=page_table.to(torch.int32),
+            max_seqlen_q=-1,
+            mask_mode=3,
+            cmp_ratio=ratio,
+            layout_q="TND",
+            layout_k="PA_BBND",
+            return_value=False,
+            metadata=metadata,
+            # -1 leaves the operator's third and fourth returns empty.
+            candidate_topk_blocks=indexer.candidate_topk_blocks if candidate else -1,
+            candidate_block_size=indexer.candidate_block_size if candidate else -1,
+        )
+        indices, _, candidate_indices, candidate_lengths = result
+        scored = indices.view(t, topk).to(torch.int32)
+        if not candidate:
+            return scored, None
+        return scored, (candidate_indices, candidate_lengths)
+
+    def _dsv41_qsli_cache(self, layer) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """The combined index-K record QSLI reads: ``[pages, page_size/8, 1, 544]``.
+
+        ``indexer_prologue_k`` in ``storage_mode=1`` packs the same K rows eight
+        to a record -- K[8, 64] as 512B, then their e8m0 scales as 32B -- which
+        is exactly the PA_BBND K layout QSLI takes
+        (quant_sparse_lightning_indexer_dsl/README.md L12-L29). Only the
+        candidate source layer writes it, so it is allocated per (ratio, source
+        slot) on first use instead of for every layer of the ratio; the consumer
+        layers reach the source's buffer through the same ``layer_mapping`` slot.
+        """
+        pool = self.token_to_kv_pool
+        item = pool.layer_mapping[layer.layer_id]
+        key = (item.compress_ratio, item.compress_layer_id)
+        cache = self._dsv41_qsli_caches.get(key)
+        if cache is None:
+            index_k = pool.get_index_k(layer.layer_id)
+            block = self._dsv41_candidate_block_size
+            pages, page_rows = int(index_k.shape[0]), int(index_k.shape[1])
+            if block <= 0 or page_rows % block:
+                raise RuntimeError(
+                    "DeepSeek-V4.1 QSLI needs candidate_block_size to divide the "
+                    f"compressed page rows, got block={block} rows={page_rows}."
+                )
+            head_dim = int(index_k.shape[-1]) * 2
+            # 32 = the prologue's e4m3 scale group (indexer_prologue_k_dsl
+            # README L40-L52: 64 payload bytes + 4 scale bytes per 128-dim row).
+            record = block * (head_dim // 2 + head_dim // 32)
+            cache = torch.zeros(
+                pages,
+                page_rows // block,
+                1,
+                record,
+                dtype=torch.uint8,
+                device=index_k.device,
+            )
+            self._dsv41_qsli_caches[key] = cache

nodes.body: Keeping the inherited whole-ring PD layout breaks a prefill worker without speculation paired with a decode worker using DSpark. `get_ring_size(2)` returns 2 for zero draft tokens and 8 for six draft tokens. At head_dim=512, `get_request_state_buf_infos()` therefore registers 8192 bytes per item on P and 32768 on D, while `transfer_indices()` addresses both by request index. Calling the existing Mooncake stride check with these registrations returns `c128_state item length mismatch for positional entry 0: prefill=8192 decode=32768`; equal-ring controls pass. Please transfer the pending state with a fixed row size and map its logical position into each peer's local ring, as the C4 state path does.

nodes.body: `_low_ratio_backend()` bypasses `__init__` and never sets `_is_dspark_algorithm`. Both V4.1 verify cases in this class consequently raise `AttributeError` at the DSpark branch in `_apply_dsv4_graph_metadata()`, before reaching the expected RuntimeError or idle behavior. Setting `_is_dspark_algorithm = False` in this fixture makes all four guard tests pass. Please initialize it explicitly so these tests exercise the non-DSpark guard.

@@ -0,0 +1,2364 @@
+"""
+Unit tests for the DeepSeek-V4.1 low-ratio (NPU) path in
+sglang.srt.hardware_backend.npu.attention.ascend_dsv4_backend and the row layout
+helpers in ...hardware_backend.npu.dsv4.dsv4_memory_pool.
+
+Everything here is pure device-agnostic torch arithmetic plus a stub for the
+``ds41`` operator module, so the suite runs on CPU without an Ascend device.
+"""
+
+import sys
+import unittest
+from contextlib import ExitStack
+from types import ModuleType, SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import MagicMock, patch
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_npu_ci
+
+register_npu_ci(est_time=8, suite="base-a-test-npu")
+
+# The backend imports ragged_verify at module level (the COMPACT verify-mode
+# guard).  It is dependency-light, so load the REAL module before the stub
+# block below shadows the speculative package parent.
+from sglang.srt.speculative.ragged_verify import RaggedVerifyMode
+
+for mod in (
+    "torch_npu",
+    "torch_npu.contrib",
+    "sgl_kernel_npu",
+    "sgl_kernel_npu.attention",
+    "sgl_kernel_npu.attention.sinks_attention",
+    "sgl_kernel_npu.norm",
+    "sgl_kernel_npu.norm.add_rmsnorm_bias",
+    "sglang.srt.speculative",
+    "sglang.srt.speculative.decoupled_spec_io",
+    "sglang.srt.speculative.spec_info",
+    "sglang.srt.speculative.eagle_info",
+    "sglang.srt.speculative.base_spec_worker",
+):
+    sys.modules.setdefault(mod, MagicMock())
+
+# Stub deepseek_v2._is_hip to avoid importing the heavy model.
+_ds2_stub = ModuleType("sglang.srt.models.deepseek_v2")
+_ds2_stub._is_hip = False
+sys.modules.setdefault("sglang.srt.models.deepseek_v2", _ds2_stub)
+
+import sglang.srt.hardware_backend.npu.attention.ascend_dsv4_backend as dsv4_backend
+from sglang.srt.hardware_backend.npu.attention.ascend_dsv4_backend import (
+    DeepseekV4AscendAttnBackend,
+    LowRatioCompressAscendBackendMixin,
+)
+from sglang.srt.hardware_backend.npu.dsv4 import dsv4_memory_pool
+from sglang.srt.hardware_backend.npu.dsv4.dsv4_memory_pool import (
+    DSV4NPUTokenToKVPool,
+    DSV41NPUSingleKVPool,
+    dsv41_quant,
+    dsv41_row_layout,
+)
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.deepseek_v4_memory_pool import (
+    DSV41_INDEX_PAGE_SIZE,
+    get_dsv4_indexer_bytes_per_token,
+)
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.registry import create_unified_radix_cache
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.unified_cache.components import ComponentType
+
+
+class _Ds41Stub(ModuleType):
+    """Stand-in for ``cann_ops_transformer.ops.ds41``.
+
+    Only the two metadata entry points are exercised by these tests; both return
+    a real int32 tensor so the graph-buffer ``torch.zeros_like`` probe works.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self):
+        super().__init__("ds41_stub")
+        self.mixed_quant_sparse_flash_mla = MagicMock(return_value=(None, None))
+        self.quant_lightning_indexer = MagicMock(return_value=(None, None, None, None))
+        self.compressor = MagicMock()
+        self.indexer_prologue_k = MagicMock()
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def mixed_quant_sparse_flash_mla_metadata(*args, **kwargs):
+        # The operator returns (2 * cube_core_num,) int32.
+        return torch.zeros(48, dtype=torch.int32)
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def quant_lightning_indexer_metadata(*args, **kwargs):
+        # QLI metadata is a fixed 1024 int32 (QLI README).
+        return torch.zeros(1024, dtype=torch.int32)
+
+
+DS41 = _Ds41Stub()
+# ``_ds41_ops`` is a module-level cached accessor; replacing the module global is
+# enough because every call site resolves it at call time.
+dsv4_backend._ds41_ops = lambda: DS41
+
+
+def _low_ratio_backend(*, ratios=(1, 2), window=128):
+    backend = DeepseekV4AscendAttnBackend.__new__(DeepseekV4AscendAttnBackend)
+    backend._dsv4_compress_ratios = (0,) + tuple(ratios)
+    backend._dsv4_unique_compress_ratios = list(
+        dict.fromkeys(backend._dsv4_compress_ratios)
+    )
+    backend._dsv4_has_low_ratio = any(
+        r in (1, 2) for r in backend._dsv4_compress_ratios
+    )
+    backend._dsv4_sliding_window_size = window
+    backend._dsv4_q_head_num = 64
+    backend._dsv4_head_dim = 512
+    backend._dsv4_index_topk = 512
+    backend._dsv4_index_n_heads = 32
+    backend._dsv4_index_head_dim = 128
+    backend.page_size = 128
+    # No candidate source by default: ``_init_dsv41_graph_metadata`` reads the
+    # candidate layer id right after seeding the plain per-ratio tables, so the
+    # stub needs the attribute even though these tests never run the QSLI path
+    # (-1 makes ``_dsv41_candidate_ratio`` return None and the seeding skip).
+    backend._dsv41_candidate_source_layer = -1
+    backend.forward_metadata = SimpleNamespace()
+    backend.graph_metadata = {}
+    # The real pool (DSV4NPUTokenToKVPool) exposes qk_nope_head_dim /
+    # qk_rope_head_dim but *no* ``head_dim``: the attention width is the
+    # backend's own cfg head_dim.  Keep the stub bare so a regression to
+    # ``pool.head_dim`` fails here (AttributeError) instead of on the A5 box.
+    backend.token_to_kv_pool = SimpleNamespace()
+    return backend
+
+
+def _batch(*, positions, out_cache_loc, seq_lens, batch_size):
+    return SimpleNamespace(
+        positions=torch.tensor(positions, dtype=torch.int64),
+        out_cache_loc=torch.tensor(out_cache_loc, dtype=torch.int64),
+        seq_lens=torch.tensor(seq_lens, dtype=torch.int32),
+        batch_size=batch_size,
+    )
+
+
+class TestRowLayout(unittest.TestCase):
+    """Row widths must match the operators' documented byte layouts.
+
+    The format follows the *side* of the attention, not the layer's compress
+    ratio: a ratio-1 aggregate is still read as ``cmp_kv``.
+    """
+
+    def test_window_row_is_the_origin_544b_layout(self):
+        # mixed_quant_sparse_flash_mla_dsl/README.md L188: ori_kv is
+        # nope[448] + rope[64] = 512 bytes of FP8 E4M3 plus 16 BF16 scales.
+        row_bytes, dtype = dsv41_row_layout(512, compressed=False)
+        self.assertEqual(row_bytes, 544)
+        self.assertEqual(dtype, torch.float8_e4m3fn)
+
+    def test_compressed_row_is_the_320b_layout_for_both_ratios(self):
+        # README L189: cmp_kv is 256 bytes of packed FP4 E2M1 plus 32 BF16
+        # scales, whatever the layer's ratio (recipes
+        # common_modules.get_kv_cache_dim(head_dim, is_compressed=True) == 320).
+        row_bytes, dtype = dsv41_row_layout(512, compressed=True)
+        self.assertEqual(row_bytes, 320)
+        self.assertEqual(dtype, torch.uint8)
+
+    def test_quant_modes_match_the_two_sides(self):
+        self.assertEqual(dsv41_quant(False), ("mxfp8_bf16", 32))
+        self.assertEqual(dsv41_quant(True), ("mxfp4_bf16", 16))
+
+    def test_index_row_is_fp4_packed_pairs(self):
+        # index_head_dim // 2 + index_head_dim // 32 == 64 + 4 == 68, the same
+        # number the CUDA pool class reports.
+        self.assertEqual(get_dsv4_indexer_bytes_per_token(128, True), 68)
+
+    def test_empty_head_dim_is_rejected(self):
+        with self.assertRaises(AssertionError):
+            dsv41_row_layout(0, compressed=True)
+
+
+class TestPoolFactory(unittest.TestCase):
+    """The V4.1 factory picks the row format from the pool's role.
+
+    The window pool and the ratio-1 compressed pool arrive with the same page
+    geometry, so keying the format off the ratio would silently give the
+    ratio-1 compressed pool the window's 544-byte fp8 rows while the ds41
+    attention op reads ``cmp_kv`` as 320-byte fp4.
+    """
+
+    def _make(self, *, compression_ratios, page_size, global_page_size, compressed):
+        import sglang.srt.hardware_backend.npu.dsv4.dsv4_memory_pool as pool_mod
+
+        calls = {}
+
+        def record(name):
+            def factory(*args, **kwargs):
+                calls[name] = kwargs
+                return name
+
+            return factory
+
+        fake_self = SimpleNamespace(
+            compression_ratios=compression_ratios,
+            c128_page_size=128,
+            qk_nope_head_dim=448,
+            qk_rope_head_dim=64,
+        )
+        with (
+            patch.object(
+                pool_mod, "DSV41NPUSingleKVPool", record("DSV41NPUSingleKVPool")
+            ),
+            patch.object(
+                pool_mod,
+                "NPUDeepSeekV4SingleKVPool",
+                record("NPUDeepSeekV4SingleKVPool"),
+            ),
+        ):
+            out = pool_mod.DSV4NPUTokenToKVPool._make_kv_pool(
+                fake_self,
+                size=1024,
+                page_size=page_size,
+                dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+                layer_num=4,
+                device="cpu",
+                enable_memory_saver=False,
+                global_page_size=global_page_size,
+                compressed=compressed,
+            )
+        return out, calls
+
+    def test_window_pool_is_the_fp8_side(self):
+        out, calls = self._make(
+            compression_ratios=(0, 1, 2),
+            page_size=128,
+            global_page_size=128,
+            compressed=False,
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(out, "DSV41NPUSingleKVPool")
+        self.assertIs(calls["DSV41NPUSingleKVPool"]["is_compressed"], False)
+        # One row per slot: the window page is the global page.
+        self.assertEqual(calls["DSV41NPUSingleKVPool"]["kernel_page_size"], 128)
+
+    def test_ratio1_compressed_pool_is_fp4_despite_the_global_page(self):
+        out, calls = self._make(
+            compression_ratios=(0, 1, 2),
+            page_size=128,
+            global_page_size=128,
+            compressed=True,
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(out, "DSV41NPUSingleKVPool")
+        self.assertIs(calls["DSV41NPUSingleKVPool"]["is_compressed"], True)
+
+    def test_ratio2_compressed_pool_is_fp4(self):
+        out, calls = self._make(
+            compression_ratios=(0, 1, 2),
+            page_size=64,
+            global_page_size=128,
+            compressed=True,
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(out, "DSV41NPUSingleKVPool")
+        self.assertIs(calls["DSV41NPUSingleKVPool"]["is_compressed"], True)
+
+    def test_v4_model_keeps_the_packed_fp8_pool(self):
+        out, calls = self._make(
+            compression_ratios=(0, 4, 128),
+            page_size=32,
+            global_page_size=128,
+            compressed=True,
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(out, "NPUDeepSeekV4SingleKVPool")
+        self.assertNotIn("DSV41NPUSingleKVPool", calls)
+
+
+class TestPairStatePool(unittest.TestCase):
+    """The ratio-2 pending-pair state must expose the physical bank the fused
+    ``ds41.compressor`` reads as ``state_cache``.
+
+    The community factory allocates the same ring but keeps the flat
+    ``page_size=1`` default, on which ``state_cache_3d`` raises; the A5 CYCLE
+    ABI addresses one request bank per ``state_block_table`` row, so the NPU
+    override has to turn the second-axis page size on.
+    """
+
+    def _make(self):
+        import sglang.srt.hardware_backend.npu.dsv4.dsv4_memory_pool as pool_mod
+
+        fake_self = SimpleNamespace(
+            num_req_slots=5,
+            qk_nope_head_dim=448,
+            qk_rope_head_dim=64,
+            device="cpu",
+            get_ring_size=lambda ratio: 2,
+        )
+        return pool_mod.DSV4NPUTokenToKVPool._make_pair_state_pool(
+            fake_self, enable_memory_saver=False
+        )
+
+    def test_pair_state_is_paged_for_the_state_cache_view(self):
+        pool = self._make()
+        self.assertEqual(pool.ratio, 2)
+        self.assertEqual(pool.page_size, 2)
+        cache = pool.state_cache_3d  # would raise on the flat default
+        self.assertEqual(cache.shape[1], 2)
+        self.assertEqual(cache.shape[2], 2 * (448 + 64))
+        # One request bank per row: every req_pool_idx is addressable.
+        self.assertGreaterEqual(cache.shape[0], 5)
+
+    def test_pair_state_row_is_the_kv_score_pair(self):
+        pool = self._make()
+        # score (second half) is -inf-initialized; kv is zeroed.
+        cache = pool.state_cache_3d
+        self.assertTrue(torch.isneginf(cache[0, :, -1]).all())
+        self.assertTrue((cache[0, :, 0] == 0).all())
+
+
+class TestIndexerBufferAccessors(unittest.TestCase):
+    """Index K and its scale live on the per-ratio index pool.
+
+    ``get_index_k``/``get_index_scale`` are defined by ``DSV41NPUIndexerPool``;
+    the token-to-KV pool has to resolve the layer's *ratio* first and then pass
+    the per-ratio ``compress_layer_id``. Reading them straight off the
+    token-to-KV pool (or passing a ``compress_layer_id`` where a ``layer_id`` is
+    expected) is an AttributeError / wrong-buffer bug.
+    """
+
+    def _fake(self, mapping, pools):
+        return SimpleNamespace(
+            layer_mapping=mapping,
+            wait_layer_transfer=lambda _lid: None,
+            _indexer_pool=lambda ratio: pools[ratio],
+        )
+
+    def test_token_to_kv_pool_exposes_both_accessors(self):
+        import sglang.srt.hardware_backend.npu.dsv4.dsv4_memory_pool as pool_mod
+
+        for name in ("get_index_k", "get_index_scale"):

+class TestPdBufferEnumeration(unittest.TestCase):
+    """``get_contiguous_buf_infos`` must describe the V4.1 pools, not nothing.
+
+    V4.1 has no C4 pool, so keying the description off ``c4_kv_pool`` returned
+    an empty main component: a PD peer would register no compressed KV and
+    transfer nothing. V4.1's main component is the per-ratio compressed KV
+    followed by that ratio's index K then index scale, one item per full page
+    (the index pools page at ``DSV41_INDEX_PAGE_SIZE``, so their item is the run
+    of index pages tiling a full page).
+    """
+
+    def _pool(self, *, ratios, page_size, kv_layers=2, index_layers=1):
+        import sglang.srt.hardware_backend.npu.dsv4.dsv4_memory_pool as pool_mod
+
+        kv_pools = {}
+        index_pools = {}
+        for ratio in ratios:
+            kv_pools[ratio] = SimpleNamespace(
+                kv_buffer=[
+                    torch.zeros((4, page_size // ratio, 1, 320), dtype=torch.uint8)
+                    for _ in range(kv_layers)
+                ]
+            )
+            index_pools[ratio] = SimpleNamespace(
+                index_k_buffer=[
+                    torch.zeros((8, DSV41_INDEX_PAGE_SIZE, 1, 64), dtype=torch.uint8)
+                    for _ in range(index_layers)
+                ],
+                index_scale_buffer=[
+                    torch.zeros((8, DSV41_INDEX_PAGE_SIZE, 1, 4), dtype=torch.uint8)
+                    for _ in range(index_layers)
+                ],
+                page_size=DSV41_INDEX_PAGE_SIZE,
+            )
+        fake = SimpleNamespace(
+            c4_kv_pool=None,
+            c128_kv_pool=None,
+            kv_pools=kv_pools,
+            page_size=page_size,
+            _indexer_pool=lambda ratio: index_pools[ratio],
+        )
+        return (
+            pool_mod.DSV4NPUTokenToKVPool.get_contiguous_buf_infos(fake),
+            kv_pools,
+            index_pools,
+        )
+
+    def test_c128_scan_of_a_v41_pool_is_empty_instead_of_raising(self):
+        import sglang.srt.hardware_backend.npu.dsv4.dsv4_memory_pool as pool_mod
+
+        fake = SimpleNamespace(c128_kv_pool=None)
+        self.assertEqual(
+            pool_mod.DSV4NPUTokenToKVPool.get_c128_kv_buf_infos(fake),
+            ([], [], []),
+        )

+    def test_each_ratio_registers_its_kv_then_index_k_then_index_scale(self):
+        page_size = 256

+            ratios=(1,), page_size=page_size, kv_layers=2, index_layers=1
+        )
+        index_pages = page_size // DSV41_INDEX_PAGE_SIZE
+        self.assertEqual(len(ptrs), 4)
+        # Ratio-1 rows are one full page wide, so its compressed KV item is one
+        # physical page; the index pool pages at DSV41_INDEX_PAGE_SIZE, so its
+        # item is the run of index pages tiling a full page (R10).
+        self.assertEqual(

+                page_size * 320,
+                DSV41_INDEX_PAGE_SIZE * 64 * index_pages,

+            ],
+        )
+        for buf, ptr in zip(

+                *kv_pools[1].kv_buffer,

+class TestIndexerRopeSource(unittest.TestCase):
+    """``_dsv41_index_full_topk`` gathers Q's RoPE from the LAYER, not the indexer.
+
+    ``DeepseekV41Indexer`` is built without ``freqs_cis``/``rotary_emb``
+    (deepseek_v4.py L1366-1372) -- only ``DeepseekV41Compressor``/``C4Indexer``
+    get them -- so reading them off the indexer raises AttributeError on the
+    first index source layer.  The reference model uses the layer's
+    ``compress_rotary_emb`` for this RoPE (recipes indexer.py L234).
+    """
+
+    def _fake_indexer(self, n_heads, index_head_dim):
+        return SimpleNamespace(
+            n_heads=n_heads,
+            index_head_dim=index_head_dim,
+            rope_head_dim=64,
+            wq_b=lambda ql: (torch.zeros(ql.shape[0], n_heads * index_head_dim), None),
+            head_weights=lambda x: torch.zeros(x.shape[0], n_heads),
+        )
+
+    def _run(
+        self, *, ratio, seq_lens, n_heads=4, index_head_dim=128, packed=64, topk=3
+    ):
+        """Run ``_dsv41_index_full_topk`` against stubbed ops; return what QLI saw."""
+        import sglang.srt.hardware_backend.npu.dsv4.dsv4_rope as rope_mod
+
+        seen = {}
+        sentinel = torch.zeros(8, 2)
+
+        class _RopeStub:
+            def __init__(self, freqs_cis, rotary_emb=None):
+                seen["freqs_cis"] = freqs_cis
+
+            # The backend reaches the table through ``for_freqs`` (a classmethod
+            # on the real Dsv4NpuRoPE), so the stub must expose it too.
+            @staticmethod
+            def for_freqs(freqs_cis, rotary_emb=None):
+                return _RopeStub(freqs_cis, rotary_emb)
+
+            def get_cos_sin(self, *args, **kwargs):
+                return (
+                    torch.zeros(1, 1, 1, 64),
+                    torch.zeros(1, 1, 1, 64),
+                )
+
+            @staticmethod
+            def apply_rotary_mul_inplace(*args, **kwargs):
+                return None
+
+        class _QLI:
+            def __call__(self, **kwargs):
+                seen["qli_kwargs"] = kwargs
+                return torch.zeros(1, topk, dtype=torch.int32), None, None, None
+
+        backend = _low_ratio_backend()
+        backend._dsv4_index_topk = topk
+        backend.forward_metadata = SimpleNamespace(
+            actual_seq_lengths_q_pa=torch.arange(0, 2, dtype=torch.int32),
+            **{
+                f"c{ratio}_index_page_table": torch.zeros((1, 2), dtype=torch.int32),
+                "kernel_metadata": {
+                    f"c{ratio}a_qli_metadata": torch.zeros(1024, dtype=torch.int32)
+                },
+            },
+        )
+        backend.token_to_kv_pool = SimpleNamespace(
+            # The K and scale buffers are per-ratio, so the pool resolves them
+            # from a layer_id -- never from a per-ratio compress_layer_id.
+            get_index_k=lambda lid: (
+                seen.setdefault("k_layer_id", lid),
+                torch.zeros((1, 64, 1, packed), dtype=torch.uint8),
+            )[1],
+            get_index_scale=lambda lid: (
+                seen.setdefault("scale_layer_id", lid),
+                torch.zeros((1, 64, 1, 4), dtype=torch.uint8),
+            )[1],
+        )
+        layer = SimpleNamespace(
+            layer_id=1,
+            compress_ratio=ratio,
+            freqs_cis=sentinel,
+            rotary_emb=None,
+            indexer=self._fake_indexer(n_heads, index_head_dim),
+        )
+        with (
+            patch.object(
+                sys.modules["torch_npu"],
+                "npu_dynamic_mx_quant",
+                lambda q, dst_type=None: (
+                    torch.zeros(q.shape[0], n_heads, packed, dtype=torch.uint8),
+                    torch.zeros(q.shape[0], n_heads, 4, dtype=torch.uint8),
+                ),
+            ),
+            patch.object(rope_mod, "Dsv4NpuRoPE", _RopeStub),
+            patch.object(DS41, "quant_lightning_indexer", _QLI()),
+        ):
+            out = backend._dsv41_index_full_topk(
+                layer,
+                torch.zeros(1, 8),
+                torch.zeros(1, 8),
+                torch.tensor([0]),
+                # seqused_k / cmp_residual_k come from this batch's seq_lens, not
+                # from a metadata tensor: seq_lens is a graph input and is
+                # refreshed every replay, while a captured buffer would keep the
+                # capture-time lengths for all later steps.
+                SimpleNamespace(seq_lens=torch.tensor(seq_lens, dtype=torch.int32)),
+            )
+        return seen, sentinel, layer, out

+    def test_query_rope_gathers_the_layer_table(self):
+        seen, sentinel, layer, out = self._run(ratio=1, seq_lens=[3])

+class TestCompressedRowIdentity(unittest.TestCase):
+    """One flat row addresses the compressed KV pool and the indexer-K pool alike.
+
+    ``fm.c{r}_loc = full_loc // ratio`` is written into the compressed pool by
+    ``kv_compress_epilog_v2`` (slot_mapping) and into the index pool by
+    ``indexer_prologue_k`` (cache_index); the operators derive that same physical
+    row again from their page tables.  That only holds while each FULL page owns
+    the consecutive index pages [k*p, k*p + k) -- the convention the shared
+    ``expand_index_page_table`` implements (it pages at DSV41_INDEX_PAGE_SIZE
+    while the compressed pools page at page_size // ratio).
+    """
+
+    def test_index_rows_equal_compressed_rows_across_a_full_page(self):
+        from sglang.srt.layers.attention.dsv4.metadata import (
+            expand_index_page_table,
+        )
+        from sglang.srt.mem_cache.deepseek_v4_memory_pool import (
+            DSV41_INDEX_PAGE_SIZE,
+        )
+
+        page_size = 256
+        table = torch.tensor([[7, 8]], dtype=torch.int32)
+        for ratio in (1, 2):
+            slots_per_page = page_size // ratio
+            self.assertEqual(slots_per_page % DSV41_INDEX_PAGE_SIZE, 0)
+            blocks_per_page = slots_per_page // DSV41_INDEX_PAGE_SIZE
+            index_table = expand_index_page_table(
+                table,
+                full_page_size=page_size,
+                compress_ratio=ratio,
+                index_page_size=DSV41_INDEX_PAGE_SIZE,
+            )
+            for row_in_page in range(page_size):
+                full_loc = 7 * page_size + row_in_page
+                # What the epilog / prologue write.
+                written = full_loc // ratio
+                # What the operators read: compressed slot q of FULL page 7 sits
+                # at column 0 * blocks_per_page + q // 64 of the index table.
+                q = row_in_page // ratio
+                column = q // DSV41_INDEX_PAGE_SIZE
+                index_page = int(index_table[0, column])
+                read = index_page * DSV41_INDEX_PAGE_SIZE + q % DSV41_INDEX_PAGE_SIZE
+                self.assertEqual(read, written, (ratio, row_in_page))
+
+    def test_compressed_pool_slot_matches_the_full_page_table_lookup(self):
+        """`c{r}_loc` is a flat *physical* row; the operator re-derives that same
+        row from `fm.c{r}_page_table`.
+
+        The compressed pool pages at `page_size // ratio`, so compressed page j
+        is FULL page j and the full page table doubles as the compressed one
+        (`_build_dsv41_ratio_metadata`).  The writer takes its index from the
+        allocator's physical slot (`out_cache_loc // ratio`) while the reader
+        resolves the *logical* compressed row through that table -- with a
+        permuted table the two only agree because both sides carry the same
+        physical page id.
+        """
+        table = torch.tensor([[5, 1, 9, 2]], dtype=torch.int32)
+        for ratio in (1, 2):
+            backend = _low_ratio_backend()
+            page_size = backend.page_size
+            slots_per_page = page_size // ratio
+            positions, out_loc = [], []
+            for full_page, phys in enumerate(table[0].tolist()):
+                for row_in_page in range(page_size):
+                    positions.append(full_page * page_size + row_in_page)
+                    out_loc.append((phys * page_size + row_in_page))
+            backend._build_dsv41_ratio_metadata(
+                _batch(
+                    positions=positions,
+                    out_cache_loc=out_loc,
+                    seq_lens=[len(positions)],
+                    batch_size=1,
+                ),
+                ratio,
+            )
+            loc = getattr(backend.forward_metadata, f"c{ratio}_loc")
+            completed = [
+                (positions[i], out_loc[i])
+                for i in range(len(positions))
+                if positions[i] % ratio == ratio - 1 and out_loc[i] >= page_size
+            ]
+            # ratio 1 masks in place, ratio >= 2 compacts; dropping the -1 skips
+            # (the documented "skip" sentinel) leaves both in position order.
+            self.assertEqual(
+                [int(v) for v in loc.tolist() if v != -1],
+                [full_loc // ratio for _, full_loc in completed],
+            )
+            for position, full_loc in completed:
+                written = full_loc // ratio
+                # What the operator reads: the LOGICAL compressed row is what the
+                # sparse indices carry; its page comes from the full page table.
+                logical = position // ratio
+                page = int(table[0, logical // slots_per_page])
+                read = page * slots_per_page + logical % slots_per_page
+                self.assertEqual(read, written, (ratio, position))
+

+class TestEagerGraphMetadataParity(unittest.TestCase):
+    """Eager prefill and aclgraph replay must derive the same rows.
+
+    They are two independent implementations of one contract: the eager builder
+    reads ``forward_batch.positions`` and compacts, the replay path derives
+    positions from ``live_seq_lens`` and compacts (ratio 2) or writes them in
+    place (ratio 1, where every real token closes its group). A divergence here
+    would make prefill and decode disagree about which slot each compressed row
+    belongs to.

+

+        metadata = SimpleNamespace(

+            kernel_metadata={},

+        backend._init_dsv41_graph_metadata(
+            metadata, bs=len(live), tokens_per_req=1, device="cpu"
+        )
+        backend.forward_metadata = metadata
+        ctx = SimpleNamespace(
+            fm=metadata,
+            bs=len(live),
+            live_seq_lens=torch.tensor(live, dtype=torch.int32),
+            forward_batch=batch,
+        )
+        backend._refresh_graph_dsv41_1d(ctx)
+        return metadata
+
+    def test_ratio_rows_match_between_eager_and_replay(self):
+        batch = _batch(
+            positions=[3, 4], out_cache_loc=[205, 208], seq_lens=[4, 5], batch_size=2
+        )
+        eager_backend = _low_ratio_backend()
+        eager_backend.forward_metadata = SimpleNamespace(
+            block_tables=torch.zeros((2, 1), dtype=torch.int32)
+        )
+        for ratio in (1, 2):
+            eager_backend._build_dsv41_ratio_metadata(batch, ratio)
+        eager = eager_backend.forward_metadata
+
+        graph = self._graph_side(_low_ratio_backend(), batch, live=[4, 5])
+
+        # ratio 1: every real token closes its group -> per-token rows.
+        self.assertEqual(eager.c1_loc.tolist(), graph.c1_loc.tolist())
+        self.assertEqual(eager.c1_loc.tolist(), [205, 208])
+        self.assertEqual(
+            eager.positions_cmp_padding_c1.tolist(),
+            graph.positions_cmp_padding_c1.tolist(),
+        )
+        # ratio 2: only the second token of a pair closes it, so row 1 is the
+        # group start (0) and the unfinished pair leaves the skip sentinel.
+        self.assertEqual(eager.c2_loc.tolist(), graph.c2_loc.tolist())
+        self.assertEqual(eager.c2_loc.tolist(), [102, -1])
+        self.assertEqual(eager.positions_cmp_padding_c2.tolist(), [2, 0])
+        self.assertEqual(
+            eager.positions_cmp_padding_c2.tolist(),
+            graph.positions_cmp_padding_c2.tolist(),
+        )
+
+    def test_mid_batch_dropped_row_matches_between_eager_and_replay(self):
+        # A dropped row *between* two live ones: ratio 2 skips it (it closes no
+        # group) and ratio 1 must leave the sentinel in place rather than
+        # compacting, so the row index still matches the latent's token order.
+        batch = _batch(
+            positions=[3, 4, 5],
+            out_cache_loc=[205, 0, 208],
+            seq_lens=[4, 0, 6],
+            batch_size=3,
+        )
+        eager_backend = _low_ratio_backend()
+        eager_backend.forward_metadata = SimpleNamespace(
+            block_tables=torch.zeros((3, 1), dtype=torch.int32)
+        )
+        for ratio in (1, 2):
+            eager_backend._build_dsv41_ratio_metadata(batch, ratio)
+        eager = eager_backend.forward_metadata
+
+        graph = self._graph_side(_low_ratio_backend(), batch, live=[4, 0, 6])
+
+        self.assertEqual(eager.c1_loc.tolist(), [205, -1, 208])
+        self.assertEqual(
+            eager.positions_cmp_padding_c1.tolist(),
+            [3, 0, 5],
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(eager.c1_loc.tolist(), graph.c1_loc.tolist())
+        self.assertEqual(
+            eager.positions_cmp_padding_c1.tolist(),
+            graph.positions_cmp_padding_c1.tolist(),
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(eager.c2_loc.tolist(), [102, 104, -1])
+        self.assertEqual(eager.c2_loc.tolist(), graph.c2_loc.tolist())
+        self.assertEqual(
+            eager.positions_cmp_padding_c2.tolist(),
+            graph.positions_cmp_padding_c2.tolist(),
+        )
+
+    def test_padding_rows_are_dropped_identically(self):
+        # Row 1 is a graph-padding row: no live tokens and the dummy-page slot.
+        batch = _batch(
+            positions=[3, 0], out_cache_loc=[205, 0], seq_lens=[4, 4], batch_size=2
+        )
+        graph = self._graph_side(_low_ratio_backend(), batch, live=[4, 0])
+        self.assertEqual(graph.c1_loc.tolist(), [205, -1])
+        # The eager path never sees padding rows (it slices to the real tokens),
+        # so its per-ratio rows are the same dense prefix.
+        eager_backend = _low_ratio_backend()
+        eager_backend.forward_metadata = SimpleNamespace(
+            block_tables=torch.zeros((1, 1), dtype=torch.int32)
+        )
+        real = _batch(positions=[3], out_cache_loc=[205], seq_lens=[4], batch_size=1)
+        eager_backend._build_dsv41_ratio_metadata(real, 1)
+        self.assertEqual(eager_backend.forward_metadata.c1_loc.tolist(), [205])
+        self.assertEqual(
+            graph.c1_loc[:1].tolist(), eager_backend.forward_metadata.c1_loc.tolist()
+        )
+
+    def test_padded_live_replay_keeps_real_slots(self):
+        # A padded replay (raw_bs < bucket bs) hands the backend the RAW,
+        # unpadded out_cache_loc (``build_replay_fb_view`` passes the original
+        # batch's).  The live rows still wrote tokens this step, so their
+        # compression rows must refresh; only the padding row skips.  The
+        # pre-fix guard treated any short vector as DP-idle and silently
+        # dropped the whole step's compression / index-K writes.
+        batch = _batch(
+            positions=[3, 4], out_cache_loc=[205, 208], seq_lens=[4, 5], batch_size=2
+        )
+        graph = self._graph_side(_low_ratio_backend(), batch, live=[4, 5, 0])
+        self.assertEqual(graph.c1_loc.tolist(), [205, 208, -1])
+        self.assertEqual(graph.positions_cmp_padding_c1.tolist(), [3, 4, 0])
+        self.assertEqual(graph.c2_loc.tolist(), [102, -1, -1])
+        self.assertEqual(graph.positions_cmp_padding_c2.tolist(), [2, 0, 0])
+        # The eager prefix (the two live rows alone) matches the graph rows.
+        eager_backend = _low_ratio_backend()
+        eager_backend.forward_metadata = SimpleNamespace(
+            block_tables=torch.zeros((2, 1), dtype=torch.int32)
+        )
+        for ratio in (1, 2):
+            eager_backend._build_dsv41_ratio_metadata(batch, ratio)
+        eager = eager_backend.forward_metadata
+        self.assertEqual(graph.c1_loc[:2].tolist(), eager.c1_loc.tolist())
+        self.assertEqual(graph.c2_loc[:2].tolist(), eager.c2_loc.tolist())
+
+
+class TestVerifyGraphGuard(unittest.TestCase):
+    """A DeepSeek-V4.1 ``target_verify`` *replay* must fail loudly (R39).
+
+    The verify arm of ``_apply_dsv4_graph_metadata`` refreshes the c4/c128
+    buffers only, so a V4.1 verify graph would scatter this step's compressed
+    rows to the previous step's slots and silently corrupt the compressed /
+    index pools. The guard has to fire for V4.1 and leave V4 alone.
+    """
+
+    class _GraphMode:
+        def __init__(self, target_verify):
+            self._target_verify = target_verify
+
+        def is_decode(self):
+            return not self._target_verify
+
+        def is_target_verify(self):
+            return self._target_verify
+
+    _REFRESHES = (
+        "_refresh_graph_seq_metadata",
+        "_refresh_graph_compress_page_tables_direct",
+        "_refresh_graph_decode_compress_1d_direct",
+        "_refresh_graph_explicit_state_block_tables",
+        "_refresh_graph_swa_metadata_direct",
+        "_refresh_graph_dspark_sparse_metadata",
+        "_refresh_graph_kernel_metadata",
+    )
+
+    def _apply(self, *, has_low_ratio, target_verify=True, is_idle_replay=False):
+        backend = _low_ratio_backend()

This test currently fails with actual `[4, 4, 0, 0]` versus expected `[2, 2, 0, 0]`. The later ratio-1 length assertion needs `[3, 3, 0, 0]` too, since `min((4 + 1) // 1, index_topk=3)` is 3.

+class _Ds41Stub(ModuleType):
+    """Stand-in for ``cann_ops_transformer.ops.ds41``.
+
+    Only the two metadata entry points are exercised by these tests; both return
+    a real int32 tensor so the graph-buffer ``torch.zeros_like`` probe works.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self):

+        self.quant_lightning_indexer = MagicMock(return_value=(None, None, None, None))

+    @staticmethod

+    @staticmethod

+
+DS41 = _Ds41Stub()
+# ``_ds41_ops`` is a module-level cached accessor; replacing the module global is
+# enough because every call site resolves it at call time.
+dsv4_backend._ds41_ops = lambda: DS41

+
+def _low_ratio_backend(*, ratios=(1, 2), window=128):
+    backend = DeepseekV4AscendAttnBackend.__new__(DeepseekV4AscendAttnBackend)
+    backend._dsv4_compress_ratios = (0,) + tuple(ratios)
+    backend._dsv4_unique_compress_ratios = list(
+        dict.fromkeys(backend._dsv4_compress_ratios)
+    )
+    backend._dsv4_has_low_ratio = any(
+        r in (1, 2) for r in backend._dsv4_compress_ratios
+    )
+    backend._dsv4_sliding_window_size = window
+    backend._dsv4_q_head_num = 64
+    backend._dsv4_head_dim = 512
+    backend._dsv4_index_topk = 512
+    backend._dsv4_index_n_heads = 32

+    backend.page_size = 128

+    # candidate layer id right after seeding the plain per-ratio tables, so the
+    # stub needs the attribute even though these tests never run the QSLI path
+    # (-1 makes ``_dsv41_candidate_ratio`` return None and the seeding skip).
+    backend._dsv41_candidate_source_layer = -1

+
+def _batch(*, positions, out_cache_loc, seq_lens, batch_size):
+    return SimpleNamespace(
+        positions=torch.tensor(positions, dtype=torch.int64),
+        out_cache_loc=torch.tensor(out_cache_loc, dtype=torch.int64),
+        seq_lens=torch.tensor(seq_lens, dtype=torch.int32),
+        batch_size=batch_size,

+
+class TestRowLayout(unittest.TestCase):
+    """Row widths must match the operators' documented byte layouts.
+
+    The format follows the *side* of the attention, not the layer's compress
+    ratio: a ratio-1 aggregate is still read as ``cmp_kv``.
+    """
+
+    def test_window_row_is_the_origin_544b_layout(self):
+        # mixed_quant_sparse_flash_mla_dsl/README.md L188: ori_kv is
+        # nope[448] + rope[64] = 512 bytes of FP8 E4M3 plus 16 BF16 scales.
+        row_bytes, dtype = dsv41_row_layout(512, compressed=False)
+        self.assertEqual(row_bytes, 544)
+        self.assertEqual(dtype, torch.float8_e4m3fn)
+
+    def test_compressed_row_is_the_320b_layout_for_both_ratios(self):
+        # README L189: cmp_kv is 256 bytes of packed FP4 E2M1 plus 32 BF16
+        # scales, whatever the layer's ratio (recipes
+        # common_modules.get_kv_cache_dim(head_dim, is_compressed=True) == 320).
+        row_bytes, dtype = dsv41_row_layout(512, compressed=True)
+        self.assertEqual(row_bytes, 320)
+        self.assertEqual(dtype, torch.uint8)
+
+    def test_quant_modes_match_the_two_sides(self):
+        self.assertEqual(dsv41_quant(False), ("mxfp8_bf16", 32))
+        self.assertEqual(dsv41_quant(True), ("mxfp4_bf16", 16))
+
+    def test_index_row_is_fp4_packed_pairs(self):
+        # index_head_dim // 2 + index_head_dim // 32 == 64 + 4 == 68, the same
+        # number the CUDA pool class reports.
+        self.assertEqual(get_dsv4_indexer_bytes_per_token(128, True), 68)
+
+    def test_empty_head_dim_is_rejected(self):
+        with self.assertRaises(AssertionError):
+            dsv41_row_layout(0, compressed=True)
+
+
+class TestPoolFactory(unittest.TestCase):
+    """The V4.1 factory picks the row format from the pool's role.
+
+    The window pool and the ratio-1 compressed pool arrive with the same page
+    geometry, so keying the format off the ratio would silently give the
+    ratio-1 compressed pool the window's 544-byte fp8 rows while the ds41
+    attention op reads ``cmp_kv`` as 320-byte fp4.
+    """
+
+    def _make(self, *, compression_ratios, page_size, global_page_size, compressed):
+        import sglang.srt.hardware_backend.npu.dsv4.dsv4_memory_pool as pool_mod
+
+        calls = {}
+
+        def record(name):
+            def factory(*args, **kwargs):
+                calls[name] = kwargs
+                return name
+
+            return factory
+
+        fake_self = SimpleNamespace(
+            compression_ratios=compression_ratios,
+            c128_page_size=128,
+            qk_nope_head_dim=448,
+            qk_rope_head_dim=64,
+        )
+        with (
+            patch.object(
+                pool_mod, "DSV41NPUSingleKVPool", record("DSV41NPUSingleKVPool")
+            ),
+            patch.object(
+                pool_mod,
+                "NPUDeepSeekV4SingleKVPool",
+                record("NPUDeepSeekV4SingleKVPool"),
+            ),
+        ):
+            out = pool_mod.DSV4NPUTokenToKVPool._make_kv_pool(
+                fake_self,
+                size=1024,
+                page_size=page_size,
+                dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+                layer_num=4,
+                device="cpu",
+                enable_memory_saver=False,
+                global_page_size=global_page_size,
+                compressed=compressed,
+            )
+        return out, calls
+
+    def test_window_pool_is_the_fp8_side(self):
+        out, calls = self._make(
+            compression_ratios=(0, 1, 2),
+            page_size=128,
+            global_page_size=128,
+            compressed=False,
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(out, "DSV41NPUSingleKVPool")
+        self.assertIs(calls["DSV41NPUSingleKVPool"]["is_compressed"], False)
+        # One row per slot: the window page is the global page.
+        self.assertEqual(calls["DSV41NPUSingleKVPool"]["kernel_page_size"], 128)
+
+    def test_ratio1_compressed_pool_is_fp4_despite_the_global_page(self):
+        out, calls = self._make(
+            compression_ratios=(0, 1, 2),

+        self.assertIs(calls["DSV41NPUSingleKVPool"]["is_compressed"], True)
+
+    def test_ratio2_compressed_pool_is_fp4(self):

+
+    def test_v4_model_keeps_the_packed_fp8_pool(self):
+        out, calls = self._make(
+            compression_ratios=(0, 4, 128),
